fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2018 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased fuel expense by approximately $44.4 million for the 2018 year.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in many years'.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense for 2018 increased $102.5 million, or 29.8 percent, compared with 2017 as the system average fuel cost per gallon increased by 26.6 percent, coupled with a 2.6 percent increase in system fuel gallons consumed on a 9.5 percent increase in system ASMs. [Derived: 186.6M × 1.026 = 191.5M gallons]
